claims.text: The material baseline is as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Alloying as-cast HfMoTaTiZr with a lighter element can reduce its density without sacrificing room- or high-temperature mechanical performance.
Microstructure optimization through processing can reduce the density of as-cast HfMoTaTiZr without sacrificing its mechanical performance.
Microstructure is the structural mediator between the proposed intervention and mechanical performance.
The intervention will produce lower density relative to as-cast HfMoTaTiZr while maintaining its mechanical performance.

contradictions.description: The proposal characterizes the intervention as specific but gives two distinct, unspecified alternatives—lighter-element alloying or microstructure optimization through processing—rather than one testable intervention.
